rows.summary: Zully Broussard donated one of her kidneys to a stranger. Her donation, combined with genetic data matching, resulted in six patients receiving transplants.
On April 6, 1996, the first Major League Soccer match was played in San Jose. The league has grown significantly, expanding from 10 to 20 teams by 2015.

Bafetimbi Gomis collapsed during a Premier League match but is now feeling well. He was treated on the pitch and spent the night in hospital as a precaution. Swansea confirmed Gomis was fine and had undergone medical tests.
